svg.text: they memorized, not workflow they need
See clicks and navigation, miss the centrifuge
Staff say "the system is fine" because they've
adapted — workarounds are invisible in interviews
Techs work around LabVantage, not with it —
sticky notes on scanners, paper checklists on benches
Barcode scanner = navigation anchor of every
workflow step; software treated scans as data input
Scan-confirm cycles organized every process step.
Redesigning scans as navigation events (not data input)
became Natera's standard methodology for lab-facing design — adopted across product teams
